content: Web game table stakes: visible mute/volume with persisted setting; audio cannot start before first user gesture (browser autoplay policy — resume AudioContext on first input); pause/resume honoring document visibility; restart in one press; respect prefers-reduced-motion by damping screenshake/vertex-wobble UI motion (not core gameplay); keyboard+mouse parity; visible focus for menus; WCAG 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions; gameaccessibilityguidelines.com as checklist.
